about: Glulam is glued from dried lamellas: it hardly shrinks or cracks, so finishing can start sooner. Profiled timber is cheaper at the start, but the walls need time to settle, and window, door and partition details must allow for shrinkage.
The choice depends on your budget, timeline and whether you want exposed timber in the interior. We set these decisions in the house design before the estimate.
Price of a turnkey timber house

Shell from $600/m², turnkey with MEP and finishes from $1,100/m². The total depends on the type and section of timber, area and number of storeys, the foundation for the soil, roof, windows and finish level.

We choose a payment schedule that suits you: 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or several instalments, starting with a 10% deposit. Photo reports every 1–2 weeks; a 24/7 online camera on site for an extra fee.

Glulam or profiled timber — which is better?
Glulam hardly shrinks or cracks, so finishing can start sooner; profiled timber is cheaper at the start but needs time to settle. We compare both options in the estimate.
It depends on the timber section and whether you will live there year-round or seasonally. We decide in the design; the roof and floor are always insulated.
